description: A digitised physical postcard: an image of its side(s), and the metadata describing it.

main.description: A postcard. The record key is a TID whose timestamp is the date the postcard was sent (or the date it was uploaded, if that's unknown; 1970-01-01 if it was sent before then), with its remaining bits taken from the image's own hash.

image.description: A 'web' format postcard image: the front of the postcard above the back (rotated so the specified flip works), with the postcard's XMP metadata embedded.

flip.description: The axis the physical postcard flips about, to keep both sides upright.

sides.description: The sides of the postcard, front first. One-sided postcards (flipNone) have a single side.

locale.description: The language the descriptions and transcriptions are written in, unless annotated otherwise.

sentOn.description: The date the postcard was sent, as YYYY-MM-DD.

thicknessUm.description: The thickness of the postcard, in micrometres.

cardColor.description: The colour of the card the postcard is made from, as #RRGGBB.

flipBook.description: Flips about a vertical axis, like a book.

flipLeftHand.description: Flips about the up-right diagonal axis, as if flipped with your left hand. The sides have different orientations.

flipCalendar.description: Flips about a horizontal axis, like a calendar.

flipRightHand.description: Flips about the down-right diagonal axis, as if flipped with your right hand. The sides have different orientations.

flipNone.description: The postcard has only one side.

description.description: A description of what this side depicts, suitable for use as alt text.

secrets.description: Regions of this side which hold private information, and should be obscured.

annotation.description: Marks up a range of the text. Offsets are zero-indexed counts of UTF-8 bytes; the start is inclusive and the end exclusive.

value.description: For 'locale' annotations, the language tag of the annotated range.

prehidden.description: False if this region still shows its private information in the image; regions are assumed to be already obscured.

points.description: The vertices of the polygon bounding the region.

point.description: A point on one side of the postcard, in ten-thousandths of that side's width (x, from the left) and height (y, from the top).

size.description: The dimensions of the front of the postcard.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees, as a string (atproto has no floating point numbers).

longitude.description: Decimal degrees, as a string (atproto has no floating point numbers).

context.description: Where this postcard came from, and who is describing it.
